description: Find gaps in the work history of one of the user's CVs and draft honest, tactful ways to explain them on the CV and in interviews. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user has a break in employment they're worried about.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: explain_takemeup_career_gaps
